riverbend-music-center.chronic.1.text: Re-entry is not permitted. The FAQ lists medically necessary bags as a possible exception to its bag policy when accompanied by the guest using them; all bags are searched. Confirm arrangements for essential items before arriving.
quote: There is no re-entry for all events at Riverbend Music Center & PNC Pavilion.

Possible exceptions include:
Medically necessary bags and diaper bags accompanied by the guest using them. All bags will be searched.
riverbend-music-center.chronic.1.reason: Retained the accompanying-user condition for the possible medical-bag exception.

great-american-ball-park.mobility.1.text: The Reds list placard/plate pickup and drop-off zones on Joe Nuxhall Way between Mehring and Freedom Ways, and at Broadway and Mehring Way. Cars, vans and small buses may enter from 30 minutes before gates open until about one hour after the game. Large school and charter/tour buses must arrange another location with Group Sales (513-765-7600).
great-american-ball-park.mobility.1.quote:
The accessible pickup/drop-off zone is located on Joe Nuxhall Way, between Mehring Way and Freedom Way, along the west side of Great American Ball Park. There is a second accessible pick/drop off zone located at the corner of Broadway and Mehring Way on the Southeast corner of the ballpark. Cars, vans and small buses displaying a valid accessible placard or valid accessible license plate will be permitted to enter the pickup/drop-off zone beginning one half (1/2) hour before gates open to approximately one (1) hour after the conclusion of the game. Large school buses and large charter/tour buses are prohibited from entering this zone. Guests traveling to the ballpark in a large school bus or large charter/tour bus should contact the Group Sales department at
(513) 765-7600
for information on bus pickup and drop-off locations.
great-american-ball-park.mobility.1.reason: Added the end time and vehicle-size exclusions to the existing arrival note.

great-american-ball-park.chronic.1.text: The Reds say accessible seating areas have electrical outlets for free recharging, specifying the top accessible row of each section. Family restrooms are listed near Terrace sections 101, 109, 120, 127 and 136, and View sections 413 and 437. The guide does not establish adult-changing equipment.
quote:
Great American Ball Park has accessible seating available in the seating areas. Accessible seating areas are equipped with electrical outlets for recharging purposes at no cost to the Guest.
Accessible seating is located in the last rows of Infield Box, Field Box, Terrace Line, Terrace Outfield, Mezzanine, Outer Mezzanine and View Level Box. The top accessible row of each section does have electrical outlets available for use.
All ADA seating is accessible by elevators and ramps.

Restrooms/Family Restrooms
Public Restrooms are conveniently located throughout Great American Ball Park. All restrooms at Great American Ball Park have diaper-changing stations available and are accessible to Guests with disabilities. Below is a list of sections where public restrooms are located throughout the ballpark:
Terrace Level
Men's: 104, 109, 114, 116, 126, 136, 142
Women's: 101, 106, 108, 115, 117, 128, 134, 141
Family: 101, 109, 120, 127, 136
View Level
Men's: 404, 412, 417, 419, 425, 429, 435
Women's: 403, 410, 415, 417, 423, 427, 433
Family: 413, 437
great-american-ball-park.chronic.1.reason: Expanded the previously nonspecific family-restroom locations and retained the charging-row detail; no adult-changing claim.

great-american-ball-park.chronic.2.text: The Reds prohibit backpacks unless specifically designed for medical or infant care; bags must fit within 16 × 16 × 8 inches and are inspected. Public Safety arranges another screening method when a medical condition prevents metal-detector screening.
quote:
Backpacks (defined as multi-pocketed bags that are worn on the back) are prohibited unless they are specifically designed for medical or infant care)
Bags cannot exceed the size of 16” x 16” x 8”

Public Safety staff will provide assistance for the screening process if the need arises, such as if a medical condition prohibits a guest from going through metal detection. In those circumstances other screening accommodations will be made.
Please Note: All carry-in items will be subject to inspection upon entry or at any time while inside of the Ballpark. Bags cannot be left unattended at any time.
great-american-ball-park.chronic.2.reason: Added the bag-size and inspection conditions; retained the medical-screening exception.

great-american-ball-park.chronic.3.text: For Reds games, re-entry requires using the designated Gapper’s Alley gate and having the ticket scanned. The re-entry paragraph requires metal detection and says no carry-in items may return through that gate; the separate smoking paragraph mentions carry-in screening instead. Confirm essential-item arrangements before leaving.
quote: Guests can use the re-entry system by reporting to the designated gate at the Gapper’s Alley, to have their ticket scanned. Guests are subject to metal detection screening upon re-entry and there will be no carry-in items permitted through the re-entry gate. If a Guest uses any other gate, other than the designated gate for re-entry to exit they will not be able to partake in the re-entry service.

There is a designated smoking area, outside of Gapper’s Alley (Gate B) behind Section 119, that is available for those that wish to smoke. Guests inside of the ballpark can use the re-entry gate at the Gapper’s Alley gates to gain access to the smoking area. Guests are subject to metal detection and carry-in item screening upon re-entry and all other entry policies remain in place. If a guest uses any other gate to exit, other than the designated gate for re-entry, they will not be able to partake in the re-entry service.
great-american-ball-park.chronic.3.reason: Preserved the re-entry carry-in restriction and the contradictory smoking-section wording.

great-american-ball-park.chronic.4.text: The Reds describe all ballpark restrooms as accessible to guests with disabilities and say they have diaper-changing stations. This is the publisher’s description; doorway, stall, transfer-space and adult-changing details are not established.
great-american-ball-park.chronic.4.quote: All restrooms at Great American Ball Park have diaper-changing stations available and are accessible to Guests with disabilities. Social distancing measures have been instituted, including closing off every other sink and for the men, every other urinal. Below is a list of sections where public restrooms are located throughout the ballpark:
great-american-ball-park.chronic.4.reason: Attributed the general accessibility statement and separated diaper changing from unverified adult-changing provision.

paycor-stadium.mobility.2.text: Before a game, the Bengals direct ADA drop-offs to the Central Avenue curb cut-out between West Pete Rose Way and Mehring Way for West Gate. Race Street and Freedom Way, outside E + O Kitchen, is another drop-off/pickup point for East Gate. The complete curb-to-seat route has not been verified.
paycor-stadium.mobility.2.quote: Prior to the game, ADA guests can be dropped off at the curb cut-out along Central Ave. between West Pete Rose Way and Mehring Way providing direct access to West Gate. ADA guests can also be dropped-off or picked-up at the corner of Race St. and Freedom Way, just outside E + O Kitchen, providing direct access to East Gate.
paycor-stadium.mobility.2.reason: Specified the actual curb segment and the second meeting point.

paycor-stadium.chronic.1.text: The general re-entry rule names medical emergencies as its only exception, while a separate service-animal policy permits relief exits with a gate manager’s advance permission. Patrons anticipating a medical-emergency exit may register at the Kettering Health First Aid Station on the north-end-zone plaza near Northeast Gate. Confirm arrangements with staff before exiting.
quote: Guests leaving the stadium before or during events will not be allowed back into the stadium. Medical emergencies are the only exceptions.

For any medical emergency while inside Paycor Stadium, notify any Paycor Stadium Team Member, who will contact medical assistance. If patrons know in advance that they may need to exit Paycor Stadium for a medical emergency, they may register at the Kettering Health First Aid Station located on the plaza level in the north endzone closest to Northeast Gate.
To relieve the animal, the handler should contact a stadium gate manager to obtain permission prior to exiting the stadium to ensure they will be granted re-entry.
paycor-stadium.chronic.1.reason: Reconciled the general medical-emergency-only re-entry rule with the separate approved service-animal relief exception on the same page.
